scientific_integrity: The core-cycle theorem is explicitly attributed to Kozlov; the complete-graph rational character and cycle-anchor component classification are acknowledged as existing. This package proves the all-graph canonical integral orientation and induced all-degree action and quotient formula.
scientific_limitations: The argument uses the previously known ordinary torus and positive core-cycle decomposition. The automorphism action on the finite component set is an input rather than an enumerated closed form; no equivariant homotopy splitting, integral quotient homology or isolated-vertex convention is claimed. No independent validation has been undertaken.
title: Canonical integral orientation and all-degree symmetry characters of graph flex complexes
